cast.name: 罗林·扎木斯兰扎布 Lool Jamsranjav
巴达木嘎拉夫·米亚塔布 Badamgarav Myatav
乌兰呼·奥索尔 Osor Ulaankhuu

director.name: 拉甫查金·道尔吉帕拉木 Ravjagiin Dorjpalam

introduction: When the music teacher is working poorly, he is asked to help the herdsmen during calving, and he reluctantly leaves with only his music and nothing else, wearing thick black sandals. On the way, he gets lost in a blizzard, and helps him when he comes across a woman who is trying to keep a lot of sheep in the storm. A young musician who discovered the value of work wrote a symphony for a shepherd girl and called it "Echo of the Cloak Rock".
